memberLink.label: Link to an existing adult member
memberLink.hint: Guardians do not need a membership or a login. Linking only pre-fills their details.

family.intro: Register the responsible adults, then link each child and choose exactly who may collect them.
family.familyNameHint: Shown on cards, labels and the check-in desk.
family.churchLocked: The church cannot be changed once a family is created.
family.adultsIntro: List the parents and any other adult who may be involved. Each adult gets a card; pickup permission is chosen per child later.
family.relationshipHint: Pick a chip or type your own.
family.canCheckIn: May bring the children for check-in
family.canCheckInHint: Off means contact-only: this adult is reachable in an emergency but cannot check children in.
family.pickupHint: Pickup permission is set separately on each child’s record.
family.summaryCheckIn: {count, plural, =0 {nobody may check in yet} one {# may check in} other {# may check in}}
family.summaryNext: Next: add each child and choose who may collect them.
family.summaryNextEdit: Changes apply to every linked child immediately.

child.ageHint: Used to place the child in the right classroom.
child.isMemberHint: Also appears in the Members directory.
child.isActiveHint: Inactive children cannot be checked in.
child.guardiansIntro: A family relationship does not automatically give pickup permission. Choose the authorized adults explicitly.
child.linkFirst: Link this adult before granting pickup.
child.noPickupWarning: Nobody is authorized to collect this child yet. Choose at least one adult.
child.pickupCount: {count, plural, =0 {No authorized pickup adult} one {# authorized pickup adult} other {# authorized pickup adults}}
child.careNotes: Allergies, additional needs and care instructions
child.careNotesPlaceholder: For example: peanut allergy — EpiPen in the blue bag. Prefers quiet corner when overwhelmed.
child.privacy: Private to the authorized children’s team. Never printed on labels or shown at the kiosk.
child.pickupNotesPlaceholder: For example: only the adults listed above; court order on file at the office.
child.photoExplain: A photo helps the team recognise the child at pickup. Record consent only after a guardian has explicitly agreed; the photo stays private to the team.
child.photoConsent: Guardian’s photograph permission has been recorded

session.title: Make room for a lovely day
session.intro: One session for one service or event. Children are counted once in this session, even when transferred between rooms.
session.name: Service / session name
session.endBeforeStart: The session must close after it opens.
session.endInPast: The closing time is already in the past. Pick a later time.
session.roomsIntro: Add a room per age group. Ages are completed months; capacity is enforced at check-in.
session.reuseNone: No earlier session for this church yet.
session.reuseError: Could not load the last setup.

errors.duplicateName: Another room already uses this name.
errors.maxBelowMin: The upper age must be at least the lower age.

hints.gap: Gap: no room for ages {from} to {to}.
hints.overlap: “{a}” and “{b}” overlap; a child in the overlap can go to either.

session.fixFirst: Fix the highlighted fields to open the session.
session.oneOpen: Only one session can be open per church at a time.

familyPage.saved: Saved. The family and linked children are shown below.
familyPage.statPickupHint: adults authorized for at least one child
familyPage.noChildrenHint: Add the first child and choose their authorized pickup adults.
familyPage.noAdultsHint: Add at least one responsible adult before registering children.
familyPage.cardsHint: Each family and each child can carry a QR card for faster check-in and verified pickup.

queue.title: Parent registration
queue.intro: Share the form, then verify each submission before creating active records or issuing cards.
queue.emptyHint: No registrations are waiting for review.

link.title: Shareable parent registration form
link.intro: Parents can register adults and children from their phone without a login. Every submission waits for a supervisor’s review.
link.disabled: The link is currently disabled. Enable it to let parents register.

review.duplicatesHint: Open each match in a new tab and compare before creating records.
review.openFamily: Open family and issue identification cards →
review.title: Supervisor review
review.retry: An earlier review was interrupted. Retrying resumes the same registration without duplicating its records.
review.guardianVerified: I have verified the submitting guardian and the pickup arrangements.
review.duplicatesChecked: I checked for existing family and child records.
review.registerAsMembers: Register these children as members (otherwise, visiting children).
review.allowDuplicate: I verified that the possible matches are different families. Create a separate family.
review.handledHint: Review and update the existing family separately. This action links the submission for your records; it does not overwrite permissions or create new children.
review.findFamilyPlaceholder: Type at least two letters of the family name
review.notePlaceholder: Who did you speak to, and what did you confirm?
review.processing: A supervisor is processing this registration. Refresh shortly to see the result.

parent.welcome: A warm welcome for your family
parent.welcomeDescription: Register your family before your visit. Our children’s team will review the details and help you get ready for check-in.
parent.unavailable: This form is unavailable. Please contact the church.
parent.submitError: Could not submit. Please try again.
parent.familyIntro: Please list yourself first as the parent or authorized guardian. You can add other responsible adults and choose pickup permissions separately for each child.
parent.childrenIntro: Add each child who will attend. Choose who may collect them; the church will verify this before issuing cards.
parent.pickupHint: Tap every adult who is allowed to pick this child up.
parent.pickupRequired: Choose at least one adult for each child.
parent.careNotes: Allergies, additional needs or care instructions (optional)
parent.careNotesPlaceholder: Only what the team needs to care well for your child.
parent.consentIntro: Please check the summary, then confirm.
parent.consent: I am a parent or authorized guardian of these children. I confirm the details and pickup choices are accurate, and give {church} permission to use these details for children’s registration, care and related contact.
parent.privacy: Only the authorized church team can review these details. Please share only the information needed to care for your children. Staff must approve the registration before cards are issued.
parent.receivedTitle: Thank you. Your registration is received.
parent.receivedBody: The children’s team will review your details and confirm guardian and pickup arrangements. At your visit, ask the welcome team for your identification cards. This form does not check a child into a service.

account.intro: Your sign-in details for the children’s workspace.
account.passwordHint: Use a password you do not use anywhere else. Shared tablets should sign out after each service.

memberEntry.title: Registering a child?
memberEntry.body: Use the children’s workspace to link a guardian and set pickup permissions. The child can also appear in Members.
